raw_segments.text: Contending, therefore, that the sexual distinction, which men have so warmly insisted upon, is
arbitrary, I have dwelt on an observation, that several sensible men, with whom I have
conversed on the subject, allowed to be well-founded.
And it is simply this, that the little chastity to be found amongst men and consequent disregard
of modesty, tend to degrade both sexes.
And further, that the modesty of women, characterized as such, will often be only the artful
